7- Paneling: Practical Example

Let us use the result from the previous definition to make interesting panelization options:


A- Manipulating Faces

1- Extrude all faces in the Z direction

2- Extrude / Offset all faces Normal to Surface.


B- Manipualting Edges:

Z direction:

1- Move one edge of the panels in the Z direction.

2- Loft the moved edges with their respective facing edges.

Normal to Surface:

3- Repeat step (1) but now the edges being moved Normal to the surface.

4- Loft the moved edges with their respective facing edges.

type_data.full_teaching_text:
7- Paneling: Practical Example

Let us use the result from the previous definition to make interesting panelization options:


A- Manipulating Faces

1- Extrude all faces in the Z direction

2- Extrude / Offset all faces Normal to Surface.


B- Manipualting Edges:

Z direction:

1- Move one edge of the panels in the Z direction.

2- Loft the moved edges with their respective facing edges.

Normal to Surface:

3- Repeat step (1) but now the edges being moved Normal to the surface.

4- Loft the moved edges with their respective facing edges.
